# Core 25: Two-block Gibbs helpers for lmerb (R)

This vignette is the R half of **Part 5**. It documents the two-block
helpers that `lmerb()` needs and that now live in **glmbayesCore**. The C++
they call is **Core-26**.

Part 4 (Core-20 through Core-20-S04) builds the design and the priors.
Part 5 is the sampler that consumes them. `lmerb()` and `rlmerb()` are still
in **lmebayes** / **lmebayesCore**. The matrix engines they call
(`rLMMNormal_reg()`, `rLMMindepNormalGamma_reg()`, `rLMMNormal_joint_iid()`,
and the known-variance and estimated-variance routes) are in this package.

Block 1 is the within-group update (the group coefficients \(b\) and, when
it is random, \(\sigma^2\)). Block 2 is the population update (\(\gamma\) and
\(\tau^2\)). In the C++ names those halves are *groups* and *population*.

## 1. What the engines call

`rlmerb()` is still in **lmebayesCore**. From there the matrix engines are:

```
rLMMNormal_reg
    .rLMM_validate_matrix_inputs
    .rLMM_validate_fixed_dispersion_prior_list
        .rLMM_validate_fixed_dispersion_vector
    .lmebayes_resolve_group_name
    .two_block_validate_pfamily_list
    .two_block_summarize_pfamily_list
    rLMMNormal_reg_known_vcov
        .rLMM_validate_sim_method
        rLMMNormal_reg_known_vcov_iid                 sim_method = "DEFAULT"
            .rLMMNormal_reg_run_iid
                rLMMNormal_joint_iid
                    .lmerb_posterior_normal_system
                    .lmerb_posterior_system_cholesky
                    build_mu_all
                .rLMM_format_v2_out
                    .two_block_as_staged_names
                .lmebayes_assemble_reg_result
        rLMMNormal_reg_known_vcov_two_bg              sim_method = "TWO_BLOCK_GIBBS"
            .rLMM_P_from_pfamily_list
            .rLMMNormal_reg_run
                .two_block_validate_block1_prior
                .rLMM_icm_at_start
                    .two_block_icm_at_start
                .rLMM_calibrate_m_convergence
                    .rLMM_rate_calibration_meta
                    two_block_rate_from_pfamily_list
                    two_block_l_for_tv
                    .two_block_cap_inner_sweeps
                rGLMM_sweep
                .two_block_tau2_start_from_pfamily
                .rLMM_format_sweep_out
                .lmebayes_assemble_reg_result
    rLMMNormal_reg_estimated_vcov                     sim_method accepted; Gibbs only
        .rLMMNormal_reg_run_with_pilot
            rGLMM_sweep
            .lmebayes_assemble_reg_result

rLMMNormal_joint_iid
    .two_block_measurement_prior_list
    .lmerb_posterior_normal_system
    .lmerb_posterior_system_cholesky
    build_mu_all

rLMMindepNormalGamma_reg                              legacy outer loop
    .rLMM_validate_dGamma_dispersion_prior_list
    .rLMM_dispersion_fix_from_prior_list
    .rLMM_icm_at_start
    .rLMM_calibrate_m_convergence
    rGamma_reg                                        one sigma^2 draw per replicate
    .rLMM_observation_mu
    .rLMMNormal_reg_run
    .rLMM_b_matrix_from_coefficients
    .rLMM_format_v2_out
    .lmebayes_assemble_reg_result

rLMMindepNormalGamma_reg_known_vcov                   rlmerb route, all dNormal
rLMMindepNormalGamma_reg_estimated_vcov               rlmerb route, some ING
    .rLMM_validate_ing_measurement_prior_list
        .rLMM_ing_measurement_prior_from_dGamma_pooled
        .rLMM_ing_measurement_prior_from_dGamma_group
    .rLMMIngNormal_reg_run_with_pilot
        .lmebayes_groupef_rank_from_Z
        .rLMM_measurement_rate_inputs
            .rLMM_measurement_disp_upper_for_rate
        .two_block_combine_rate_envelopes
        .two_block_pilot_marginal_ub_from_coefficients
        .rGLMM_sweep_ing_block1
            .two_block_block1_ing_all_chains
                .two_block_block1_ing_one_chain
                    .two_block_block1_ing_prior_list_one_chain
                    .two_block_block1_prep_one_chain
                    .two_block_block1_envelope_draw_one_chain
                        .rIndepNormalGammaRegBlockInd_cpp     pooled sigma^2
                    .two_block_block1_ing_group_draw_one_chain
                        .rLMM_ing_prior_list_for_group
                        .rLMM_ing_one_group_draw              per-group sigma^2
                            .rLMM_ing_prior_draw_one_group
                                .rLMM_ing_sample_sigma2
                            .rLMM_ing_prior_list_subset
                .two_block_batch_b_assign_slice
                .two_block_batch_iters_ranef_add
            .two_block_block2_all_chains
            .rGLMM_sweep_save_ing
        .rLMM_format_ing_sweep_out
        .lmebayes_assemble_reg_result
```

`sim_method = "DEFAULT"` on a fully Gaussian model with fixed variance
components draws independent replicates from the exact normal posterior.
Every estimated-variance route uses `rGLMM_sweep()`.

## 2. The sweep

`rGLMM_sweep()` (`R/rGLMM_sweep.R`) runs `n_chains` replicate chains for
`inner_sweeps` sweeps. Each sweep updates every chain's groups state, then
every chain's population state.

```
rGLMM_sweep()
    .rGLMM_sweep_initialize()
    .two_block_tau2_start_from_pfamily()
        .two_block_tau2_ref_from_pfamily()          R/two_block_tau2_ref.R
    .two_block_block1_all_chains()                  groups update, in R
        .two_block_block1_prep_all_chains()
            .two_block_block1_prep_one_chain()
                .two_block_batch_fixef_chain()
                build_mu_all(use_cpp = FALSE)
                    build_mu_all_r()
                .two_block_block1_prior_with_tau2()
                    .two_block_block1_prior_with_tau2_r()
        .two_block_block1_draw_all_chains()
            rGLMM_Re_Draw()
                .two_block_block1_draw_block()
                    rNormal_reg_group()             Gaussian lmerb
            .two_block_block1_draw_reorder()
                .two_block_block1_reorder_b_r()
                .two_block_block1_iters_mean_r()
    .two_block_block2_all_chains()                  population update
        two_block_block2_one_chain_cpp()
            .two_block_block2_one_chain_cpp()       C++ one chain (Core-26)
    .two_block_snapshot_fixef_stats()
    .two_block_snapshot_fixef_cov()
    .two_block_snapshot_disp_stats()
    .rGLMM_sweep_save()
        build_mu_all()                              default use_cpp = TRUE
    .two_block_build_sweep_history()
```

The groups half of the sweep is R. `use_cpp` for the prior refresh, the row
reorder, and the envelope-iteration summary is `FALSE` on this path, so the
`_r` helpers run. `use_cpp_block2` must be `TRUE`: the population half is
the C++ one-chain update. The arguments `use_cpp_tau2_row`,
`use_cpp_b_slice`, and `use_cpp_iters_ranef_add` are accepted by
`rGLMM_sweep()` and ignored there.

Progress bars (`.two_block_progbar_prefix()`, `.two_block_progress_bar()`,
`.two_block_progress_bar_finish()`) and `.two_block_lapply_chains()` sit
under the same loops. `.two_block_ensure_batch_b_dimnames()` restores
dimnames on the group-coefficient array after each groups update.

| File | Role in the sweep |
|------|-------------------|
| `R/rGLMM_sweep.R` | `rGLMM_sweep()` |
| `R/two_block_batch_gibbs.R` | Batch state, groups update, population dispatch, snapshots |
| `R/two_block_lmm_staged_sweep_outer.R` | `.rLMMNormal_reg_run_with_pilot()`, `.rLMM_format_sweep_out()` |
| `R/build_mu_all.R` | `build_mu_all()`, `build_mu_all_r()`, `.lmerb_validate_design()` |
| `R/rcpp_wrappers_two_block.R` | `.two_block_build_mu_all_cpp()`, `.two_block_block2_one_chain_cpp()` |
| `R/two_block_sweep_history.R` | History object and `print.two_block_sweep_history()` |

`.rLMMNormal_reg_run_with_pilot()` is the estimated-variance wrapper: an
optional pilot stage, then a main `rGLMM_sweep()`, then
`.rLMM_format_sweep_out()`.

### Sweep history

`rGLMM_sweep()` always stores a `two_block_sweep_history` object.
`print()` dispatches to `print.two_block_sweep_history()`, which calls
`.two_block_filter_sweep_history_table()`,
`.two_block_print_sweep_history_body()`,
`.two_block_print_disp_history_body()`, and
`.two_block_sweep_history_header_n()`.
`.two_block_fixef_mode_at()` (in `R/two_block_batch_gibbs.R`) looks up the
iterated-conditional-mean reference while the history is built.

### Random measurement dispersion

When Block 1 dispersion is random, the groups update is the independent-block
envelope sampler. `.rGLMM_sweep_ing_block1()` in `R/rLMM_reg.R` drives it
and calls:

| Function | File | Role |
|----------|------|------|
| `.two_block_batch_b_assign_slice()` | `R/two_block_batch_gibbs.R` | Write one chain's \(b\) (R reference) |
| `.two_block_batch_iters_ranef_add()` | `R/two_block_batch_gibbs.R` | Add envelope iteration counts (R reference) |
| `.rIndepNormalGammaRegBlockInd_cpp()` | `R/rcpp_wrappers_two_block.R` | One `.Call` for centering, build, dispersion, and simulation |

Each of those batch helpers requires its `use_cpp_*` flag to be `FALSE`.

## 3. Posterior mean

Gaussian `lmerb()` with `simulate = FALSE`, and the Gibbs start when the
caller does not supply `fixef_start`, both use the exact joint mean.

```
.two_block_icm_at_start()                     R/two_block_measurement_prior.R
    .two_block_normalize_family()             R/two_block_rNormal_reg.R
    .two_block_measurement_prior_list()
    lmerb_posterior_mean()                    R/lmebayes_posterior_icm.R
        .lmerb_validate_design()
        .lmerb_validate_measurement_prior_list()
        .lmerb_posterior_normal_system()
        .lmerb_posterior_b_given_gamma()
            build_mu_all()
```

`.two_block_icm_at_start()` requires `family` to be Gaussian.

`lmerb_posterior_covariance()` solves the same system for
\(M^{-1}\), the exact covariance of the stacked population coefficients.
Convergence plots (still in **lmebayesCore**) use it.
`rLMMNormal_joint_iid()` Cholesky-factors the same system through
`.lmerb_posterior_system_cholesky()`.

`R/two_block_rNormal_reg.R` holds the checks the engines share:
`.two_block_validate_block1_prior()`,
`.lmebayes_resolve_group_name()`, `.two_block_validate_pfamily_list()`, and
`.two_block_summarize_pfamily_list()`.

Plug-in \(\tau^2\) values live in `R/two_block_tau2_ref.R`:

| Function | Used for |
|----------|----------|
| `.two_block_tau2_plug_in_from_pfamily()` | One component: fixed dispersion, or \(E[\tau^2]\) for an inverse-gamma component |
| `.two_block_tau2_plug_in_vector()` | Named vector of those plug-ins |
| `.rLMM_P_from_pfamily_list()` | \(P = \mathrm{diag}(1/\tau^2_k)\) for the known-variance two-block route |
| `.two_block_tau2_ref_from_pfamily()` | Chain start and rate calibration (`rate/shape` for an inverse-gamma component) |
| `.two_block_tau2_start_from_dispersion_draws()` | Main-stage start from pilot dispersion draws |

## 4. Rate bound and pilot

`two_block_rate_from_pfamily_list()` builds the Remark-8 rate used to choose
`inner_sweeps`. The stack is in `R/two_block_ergodicity.R`:

```
two_block_rate_from_pfamily_list()
    two_block_rate()
        .two_block_rate_inputs()
        .two_block_S_P11()
        .two_block_gen_eigen()
            .two_block_print_remark8_precision_stop()
        .two_block_warn_lambda_star_slow()
            .two_block_lambda_star_slow_threshold()
            .two_block_lambda_star_one_tol()
two_block_l_for_tv()
    two_block_tv_bound()
        .two_block_tv_bound_one()
            .two_block_erfn()
    .two_block_uncertified_l_fallback()
    .two_block_cap_inner_sweeps()
```

`print.two_block_rate()` prints a rate object.
`two_block_mode_weights()` and `print.two_block_mode_weights()` support the
pilot upper bound.

Pilot planning is `R/two_block_pilot_cost.R` and `R/two_block_pilot_helpers.R`.
The estimated-variance engine (still in **lmebayesCore**) calls
`.two_block_pilot_will_run()`, `.two_block_resolve_pilot_plan()`,
`.two_block_print_pilot_plan()`, `.two_block_pilot_ub_from_coefficients()`,
and `.two_block_print_pilot_stage_diagnostics()`.
`.two_block_validate_gap_tol()` (`R/two_block_measurement_prior.R`) checks
the optional gap tolerance. `.two_block_m_pilot_from_gap()` turns a gap
tolerance into a pilot sweep count.
`.two_block_as_staged_names()` labels pilot and main output.

```
.two_block_resolve_pilot_plan()
    two_block_optimize_pilot_cost()
        two_block_pilot_sampling_cost()
            two_block_m_convergence_for_pilot_start()
                two_block_d0_pilot_start()
                two_block_l_for_tv()
.two_block_pilot_ub_from_coefficients()
    .two_block_pilot_chisq_test()
        .two_block_fixef_colmeans()
    two_block_mode_weights()
```

When the measurement variance is also random, the bound is the envelope of
the population rate and a marginal groups rate
(`R/two_block_ergodicity_ing_marginal.R`):

```
.two_block_pilot_marginal_ub_from_coefficients()
    .two_block_lambda_star_marginal_over_draws()
        .two_block_marginal_group_setup()
            .two_block_shape_rate_group_lookup()
.two_block_combine_rate_envelopes()
```

## 5. Files

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `R/rLMM_reg.R` | `rLMMNormal_reg()`, `rLMMindepNormalGamma_reg()`, and their routes |
| `R/rLMMNormal_joint_iid.R` | Exact iid draws for known variance components |
| `R/lmebayes_reg_result.R` | `.lmebayes_assemble_reg_result()`, `.lmebayes_groupef_rank_from_Z()` |
| `R/rGLMM_sweep.R` | Sweep driver |
| `R/two_block_batch_gibbs.R` | Groups and population batch steps |
| `R/two_block_lmm_staged_sweep_outer.R` | Pilot-then-main wrapper |
| `R/two_block_sweep_history.R` | History build and print method |
| `R/build_mu_all.R` | Per-group prior means |
| `R/rcpp_wrappers_two_block.R` | The three `.Call` wrappers `lmerb` uses |
| `R/lmebayes_posterior_icm.R` | Exact Gaussian mean and covariance |
| `R/two_block_measurement_prior.R` | Measurement-prior list and Gaussian start |
| `R/two_block_rNormal_reg.R` | Shared input checks |
| `R/two_block_tau2_ref.R` | \(\tau^2\) plug-ins |
| `R/two_block_ergodicity.R` | Rate, total-variation bound, mode weights |
| `R/two_block_pilot_cost.R` | Pilot cost and the resolved pilot plan |
| `R/two_block_pilot_helpers.R` | Pilot diagnostics and the coefficient upper bound |
| `R/two_block_ergodicity_ing_marginal.R` | Marginal groups rate bound |

These functions are in the package namespace. Export, and the move of
`rlmerb()` itself, are later steps. See **Core-26** for the C++ behind
`build_mu_all()`, the population one-chain update, and the independent-block
envelope sampler.
